status: preregistered before r5 pilot, replay, or cache candidate
purpose: Qualify the exact ffn_down Q4_K-to-F16 weight cache at c64 against a reproducible same-binary batched control surface.
hardware: Two local Intel Arc Pro B70 cards; no remote host.
fixed_configuration: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M, llama.cpp SYCL TP2 tensor 1,1, MTP0, normal MMQ Q4_K reorder, WDC and WDC pre-reorder off, 64 pinned slots, context 8192, batch 1024, ubatch 256, FUSE_EXT=31, temperature 0, prompt cache off, 128 generated tokens per request.
admission_fix: LLAMA_SERVER_QUEUE_SETTLE_MS is default-off. In the r5 binary it applies to every nonempty queue burst; the prior one-shot implementation was consumed by a startup/internal task and admitted one HTTP request before the other 63.
ordered_arms: Fresh candidate-off fixed-cohort pilot; freeze its complete token-ID outputs only after cache, completion, collision, GPU-health, and cleanup gates pass.
Fresh candidate-off replay against the frozen batched oracle; require 64/64 exact complete token-ID identity.
Fresh ffn_down exact-cache candidate against that already-frozen oracle; require 64/64 exact complete token-ID identity.
Repeat the candidate once before promotion.
advance_rule: Do not run the candidate unless the control replay is 64/64 exact. Do not promote unless both candidate runs are 64/64 exact, cache liveness is present only in candidates, all cached-token counts are zero, all health gates pass, and aggregate throughput improves over controls.
quality_boundary: The fixed batched control oracle isolates the default-off optimization from ordinary batch-shape numerical drift. The independent 12-prompt cold realistic suite must also remain 12/12 exact; it passed for the cache candidate before this preregistration.
publication_policy: No fixture-gamed headline, prompt/output cache, interpolation, extrapolation, failed-arm speed, or sequential-oracle relabeling. This is an aggregate c64 result only.
